text:
maria: Heads-up — we need a new GPU node pool in us-east4 for batch fine-tuning and some latency-sensitive inference jobs. Current us-east1/us-west pools are hitting quota and eviction churn is high in us-west2.

maria: Proposal: create a mixed pool `gpu-mixed-us-east4` with two SKUs: A10G (primary, cheaper) and 1-2 H100 nodes reserved for low-latency workloads. Use preemptible for A10G with a small on-demand fallback. ClusterAutoscaler rules to prefer A10G but spin H100 only for labels `workload=low-latency`.

ash: +1 on mixing SKUs. Quick Q: what min/max are you thinking? autoscaler needs headroom or we'll see cold-starts.

maria: Min 0 for A10G (batch-friendly) with max 80 GPUs (spread across AZs). H100 pool min 0, max 4, but pinned to zone-a for NUMA locality. Can set the H100 pool as dedicated (no preemptible).

cheng: What about regional quota? I just ran a quota check and us-east4 has limited GPU cores left. devops-bot, can you paste the quota output?

devops-bot: Quota check: us-east4: GPUs remaining by SKU -> A10G: 120, H100: 2, A100: 0. CPU cores: 3200 available. Note: VPC egress per-project is 3.5Tb/mo remaining in us-east4.

ash: H100 only 2 left — risky if we need 4. Might need quota request before we provision H100-capacity.

oliver: Agree. Also watch node IP allocation — the last pool we added exhausted /24s in that subnet and kube-proxy started flailing. Can we use ENI ip-per-pod or increase subnet?

maria: Good catch. Plan: create new subnet us-east4-gpu-subnet /22 for the pool and enable secondary IP ranges for pods. I'll open a ticket to request H100 quota bump today.

cheng: Also think about preemptible fallback strategy: prefer preemptible A10G but keep a small on-demand buffer (3 nodes) in the same AZ to absorb churn during large batch runs. Otherwise autoscaler will thrash.

ash: For autoscaler config, recommend these knobs:
```yaml
scaleDownDelay: 10m
balanceSimilarNodeGroups: true
expander: priority
minReplicas:
  - group: gpu-a10g
    min: 0
  - group: gpu-h100
    min: 0
maxReplicas: 80
```
Set pod disruption budgets for training pods so they don't get evicted mid-checkpoint.

maria: Will add PDBs to helm charts. Also we'll taint the H100 pool: `gpu-type=h100:NoSchedule` and use tolerations only for low-latency workloads. Keeps scheduler predictable.

oliver: Network egress — some customers in us-east will hit egress quotas when we move large datasets. Suggest staging data in region (GCS us-east4) and enabling private Google access for nodes.

maria: Yep, data staging plan in place. I'll add a note to onboarding docs: prefer same-region storage to avoid cross-region egress costs.

cheng: Cost check: preemptible A10G reduces GPU cost ~70% but increases scheduling failures. We should set up a simple simulator to see expected preemption rate per week given current spot market. I can run a 7-day simulation next week.

maria: Cool. Action items: 1) I'll open infra ticket to create `gpu-mixed-us-east4` subnet + node pools (A10G preemptible, H100 on-demand). 2) cheng will run quota and spot-sim and request H100 quota bump if needed. 3) ash will draft ClusterAutoscaler YAML and PDB guidance. 4) oliver will size subnet and VPC settings to avoid /24 exhaustion.

oncall-bot: Reminder: schedule a 1h canary rollout window for new pool to watch scheduler/KSAs/metrics. Recommend 1pm PT tomorrow.

maria: Thanks — I'll create the ticket and ping infra-ops when it's ready. If H100 quota doesn't arrive, we fallback to A100 preemptible + dedicated A10G for latency, but prefer H100 if quota approved.

ash: Sounds good. :thumbsup:

cheng: I'll post the simulation results once done, should inform pool sizing.

oliver: I'll pre-allocate the /22 and add notes to the terraform module.

maria: OK closing the thread — will post updates in this thread when tickets move.
